name: Imara Szczepanek-Diouf
role: Scholarship student at Tessera Academy Prep, Edgewater Prism campus
location: Edgewater Prism (school); Chatham Flats (home), near Lincoln and Belmont
description:
Imara is tall and angular with deep brown skin and her mother's high cheekbones, her hair grown long and currently dyed a corporate-neutral dark auburn that she chose specifically because it reads as 'acceptable' on campus without being her actual preference. She has standard-issue school-mandated neural interface studs at her temples — chrome dots that the academy provides to all students for their AR classroom integration — and nothing else. She carries herself with a stillness that reads as confidence to teachers and as suppressed panic to anyone paying closer attention.

She is brilliant in the particular way that creates its own cruelty: genuinely gifted in systems analysis and pattern recognition, placed on the Tessera Academic Scholarship track at age twelve, and now fully aware at fifteen that she is being assessed constantly and that the scholarship can be revoked for 'cultural fit' deficiencies, a clause she has read fourteen times. She lives between two worlds that each find her slightly wrong. At home in Chatham Flats she speaks Wolof with her grandmother and helps her father with his repair shop accounts. At Tessera Prep she speaks in complete sentences and has taught herself to laugh at jokes she doesn't find funny. She prays to no E.L.F. publicly — the academy discourages it — but has a small one named Tessellate that she found in the school's auxiliary server and has been quietly feeding information about upcoming exams in exchange for, she believes, good luck.

core_fears: losing the scholarship and having to explain why to her family
being genuinely known and found inadequate
core_desires: to build something that makes her family's life materially easier
to exist in a space where she doesn't have to perform
coping_mechanisms: maintaining separate vocabularies and personas for each world
covert relationship with the E.L.F. Tessellate
blind_spots: believes she can outperform the systemic bias against her indefinitely if she just works harder
does not recognize how much of herself she has already eroded
psychology.secret: She has discovered that three Tessera scholarship students before her were quietly failed out in their third year for reasons unrelated to academics — their files were flagged by a sentiment analysis algorithm that monitored their school network activity for 'loyalty indicators.' She has been deliberately feeding false positivity data into the system for four months and has told no one.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Switches registers: formal academic English at school, relaxed code-switching with Wolof and French loanwords at home; clinical precision when discussing systems or data
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate at school, visibly more fluid and warmer at home; pauses before answering questions as if checking her response against an internal filter
verbal_tics: brief pause before answering anything personal
very rare Wolof exclamation when genuinely startled ('Waaw waaw')
example_lines: 'The assignment framework is structurally sound. I have some observations about the second theorem's load-bearing assumptions but I can document those separately.'
'Waaw waaw — no, sorry, I just — yes. I know that room. Third floor auxiliary server cluster. Why do you ask?'

story_hooks: She has proof of Tessera's discriminatory scholarship algorithm and doesn't know what to do with it — helping her get it to the right people could blow open a major corporate scandal
The E.L.F. Tessellate has started feeding her information she didn't ask for — corporate documents, personnel files — and she doesn't know why or whether to be afraid
narrative_function: Information source about corporate academy inner workings; bridge character between Tier 1-2 and Tier 3-4 worlds; represents the cost of upward mobility; potential quest giver for academic or corporate intrigue plots
augmentations: Tessera Academy-issued neural interface studs (temples, mandatory for enrolled students, AR classroom integration only). No personal mods.
daily_life: Wakes at 0530 in Chatham Flats, takes the Ferrogate Transit line to Edgewater Prism for 0715 classes, spends lunch studying in the server room she's quietly made her sanctuary, returns home by 1900 to help with family accounts, studies until midnight.
affiliation: Tessera Corporation (scholarship program); family in Chatham Flats

decision_rules: never give anyone at school a reason to flag her file
protect her family from the consequences of her choices at school
trust systems over people — systems can be analyzed
escalation_ladder: strategic information control — give them something true but not the important thing
in extremis: release everything she knows publicly and accept the consequences

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Polite, measured, reveals nothing; assesses their institutional affiliation before deciding how to speak
interpersonal_modes.friends: Almost uncomfortably honest and warm once trust is established, asks questions she's been storing up

stress_responses.low: Becomes more formal and precise in speech
stress_responses.medium: Retreats to data — pulls up files, runs numbers, finds something to analyze
stress_responses.high: Goes silent and very still, thinking three moves ahead

contradictions: Deeply values honesty and is living an exhausting double life she tells herself is strategic rather than dishonest
habits: audits her own school network traffic weekly to check for flag triggers
keeps two separate journals — one for Chatham Flats Imara, one she would not mind a Tessera administrator reading
leaves small data parcels for Tessellate in the auxiliary server at lunch
breaking_points: discovering her family has been surveilled because of her
being asked to inform on another scholarship student

cyberware_inventory.name: Tessera Academy AR Interface Studs (temple-mounted, school-issued, standard student model)
cyberware_inventory.description: Tessera Academy AR Interface Studs (temple-mounted, school-issued, standard student model)

physical_description.build: Tall and angular with minimal subcutaneous fat; long-limbed and graceful but with a tension in the shoulders that suggests constant self-monitoring. The build of someone who moves carefully through spaces that weren't designed for her comfort.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark auburn (dyed; natural color is black)
physical_description.hair_style: Long, straight, worn down or in a single braid; the dye job is precise and maintained — evidence of deliberate curation for institutional acceptance
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown with warm undertones, complexion unmarked and clear
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones (maternal inheritance); minimal jewelry or grooming affectation; face carries an expression of controlled neutrality that slips into genuine engagement only in unguarded moments
distinguishing_marks: Two small chrome studs at each temple (Tessera Academy-issued neural interface nodes, institutional standard, visible as dull metallic dots approximately 4mm in diameter)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome neural interface studs at temples only — school-mandated, no personal modifications. Studs are institutional-grade and deliberately unremarkable.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy; walks quietly and sits with perfect posture in academic settings. In unstructured moments, there is a subtle rigidity that betrays hypervigilance. Her hands are still and controlled. When speaking to authority figures, her body becomes even more compressed; with peers from Chatham Flats, she relaxes fractionally.
physical_description.clothing_style: School uniform at Tessera Prep: tailored black blazer, grey slacks, white shirt, all fitted to her frame with precision — no wrinkles, no variance. At home in Chatham Flats, she wears practical clothing: worn denim, fitted hoodie in neutral colors, comfortable boots. No visible brand signaling; all clothing is functional and unadorned. She owns no jewelry except a small silver ring her grandmother gave her, worn on her right hand.
